title: Understanding Collinearity
text: Collinearity occurs when two or more predictor variables in a regression model are highly correlated, meaning they contain similar information about the variance in the response variable.

title: Correlation Matrix Analysis
text: Look at the correlation values between $$critic_1$$ and $$critic_2$$. A high absolute value indicates strong correlation, which can lead to collinearity issues.

title: Impact of Collinearity
text: Collinearity can make it difficult to determine the individual effect of each predictor on the response variable, as they may be explaining the same variance.
